channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Telangana Gears Up for India’s First Fully Digital Census from May 11, House Listing Operations to Begin Statewide
item.description: Telangana gears up for India’s first fully digital Census from May 11. House Listing Operations to begin statewide with mobile app-based real-time data collection.

item.title: Make Mayors, Municipal Chairpersons Part of 99-Day Programme: CM Revanth Reddy
item.description: CM Revanth Reddy directs officials to make mayors and municipal chairpersons' part of the 99-day programme in Telangana. Focus on solar power, welfare schemes and transparency.

item.title: “Well, Done, Mahesh”: Rahul Gandhi Commends TPCC Chief Mahesh Kumar Goud for 10-Day Training Camp
item.description: Rahul Gandhi says “Well done, Mahesh” as he commends TPCC Chief Mahesh Kumar Goud for successfully conducting a 10-day DCC training camp in Telangana.

item.title: UPSC CSE 2025 Final Result Likely in 2-3 Days; Candidates Await Merit List for IAS, IPS
item.description: UPSC CSE 2025 final result likely in 2-3 days. Personality test completed, merit list for IAS, IPS and other services expected in first week of March.

item.title: AIMIM Legislators Lead Protest March in Hyderabad Against Killing of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
item.description: AIMIM MLAs Jaffer Hussain Meraj, Mir Zulfiqar Ali and MLC Riyaz Ul Hasan Effendi join Hyderabad protest from Darbar E Hussaini to Darul Shifa against killing of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Scorching Sun in Telugu States: Temperatures Touch 34°C, IMD Predicts Further Rise in Telangana and AP
item.description: Scorching sun in Telugu states as temperatures touch 34°C. IMD predicts further rise in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana with dry weather for next three days.

item.title: Massive Fire Accident in Bachupally Near Pragathi Nagar Furniture Shops, Cylinder Blast Triggers Panic
item.description: Massive fire accident in Bachupally near Pragathi Nagar furniture shops after cylinder blast. Fire spreads to nearby shops; firefighters working to control flames.

item.title: Hyderabad Police Midnight Mock Drill: Golconda Zone Mobilizes 70% Force Within One Hour
item.description: Hyderabad Police Golconda Zone conducted a midnight mock drill mobilizing nearly 70% of its force within one hour near Masab Tank to test emergency response and law-and-order preparedness.

item.title: Iran Drone Attack in Kuwait: Six US Soldiers Killed at American Military Base
item.description: Iran drone attack in Kuwait kills six US soldiers at a US military base in Port Shuaiba after a drone bypassed air defenses and hit a bunker, raising tensions across the Gulf region.

item.title: Student Missing After Swimming in Pond in Shadnagar, Search Operation Underway
item.description: A student named Raju from Mahatma Jyotiba Phule BC Welfare Hostel went missing after swimming in a pond in Shadnagar’s Raikal area. Fire department teams have launched a search operation.
